title: MV Problem with states in Yanfly ATB plugin

posts.author: ZanPsio
posts.body:
Hello, I'm new in Rpg Maker MV (also I'm not english speaking so this post could be a little confusing to read and posibly in the wrong place). The subjet is the next:
When a enemy is applied with a state that deals damage by percentage, something like bleeding or poison, It stars to suffer damage continously until It is its turn/action. I'm using the yanfly plugin for atb and others like the battle engine (also of yanfly but mainly yanfly because it gives me problems with others plugins). I wanted to know if there is a solution to this, to be honest something like the damage is only taken at the end or start of the action of the affected by the state.
I tried to put the auto elimination of the state by end of actions or turns but it stills the same. I also editted things in the atb pluggin, but only the charge bar to be instantly (in other words, to not wait until the second bars fulls to a action to ocurs).
Edit: I also tried to change the full turn value on the battle engine core but it keeps happening.
